description: Bifolio containing an account in Arabic script and Greek/Coptic numerals. Begins on the lefthand side of recto. The two columns on verso mention various Dārs, e.g. Dār [...] al-Yahūdī, and Dār al-Ṣabāḥ is mentioned multiple times, once in the context of construction (ʿimāra). There is a ḥamdala and taṣliya at the bottom of the lefthand side of verso. Needs further examination.
description_he: מסמך בכתב ערבי ובספרות יווניות/קופטיות. דרוש בדיקה.
